description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, showing the proportion of each source. The chart is divided into 13 slices, each representing a distinct data source. The slices are labeled with their corresponding names and percentage values, and are colored differently. The largest slice, NQ (blue), accounts for approximately 31.3%, followed by FEVER (light blue) at 16.1%, SNLI (orange) at 15.4%, and VITAMINC (brown) at 13.0%. The remaining slices, in decreasing order of size, are MULTINLI (red) at 11.3%, ANLI (yellow) at 4.6%, FACTCC (green) at 2.6%, ENTFA (dark green) at 1.8%, XSUMHUL (purple) at 1.6%, SCITAIL (pink) at 1.2%, and MULTIFC (light green) and PUBHEALTH (dark orange) both at 0.5%, with SCIFACT (grey) being the smallest at 0.1%. The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are shown outside the slices, connected by lines to their corresponding sections, and the slices are not visually emphasized. The slices are arranged in a way that the largest slice is positioned at the top, with the others distributed around it in a clockwise direction, generally ordered from largest to smallest.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising 13 slices. Each slice represents a specific data source with distinct labels, colors, and percentage values. The largest data source is NQ, accounting for approximately 31.3% of the dataset, followed by FEVER at 16.1%. SNLI and MULTINLI are the next largest contributors, with 15.4% and 11.3%, respectively. Notably, VITAMINC shows a steady decline in its contribution compared to previous years, now accounting for only 8.0% of the dataset. Additionally, SCIFACT and PUBHEALTH are among the smallest contributors, with SCIFACT slightly exceeding PUBHEALTH at 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each data source in the training set.
